description: Rank the entities of one entityType by IODA's outage summary score over an explicit Unix-second window of at most 31 days, such as the countries or a country's regions hit hardest this week. Rows keep IODA's order, descending scores.overall. IODA merges overlapping events from different sources, scores each merged event as the product of its sources' scores, and sums the merged events into overall; each <source>.<method> key sums that source's event scores. Scores are window totals for ranking the rows of one request, not current status, and are not comparable across requests with different windows. Add entityCode for one entity, or relatedToType and relatedToCode to rank entityType entities within one country, region, ASN, or geoasn; large type-only rankings can time out. Event-start selection includes until, so adjacent windows can duplicate boundary detections. ignoreMethods excludes source.method, source.*, or *.method upstream before scoring; keep exclusions fixed when comparing rankings or drilling into events and alerts. An empty result is not an all-clear. Pages are zero-based; keep filters and limit fixed.

entityCode.description: Two-letter country code, IODA numeric region code, decimal ASN (AS prefix accepted), or geoasn code joining an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities and pass a returned code here.

entityType.description: country, region, asn, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country); whitespace and case are normalized.

extendWindowSeconds.description: Seconds before from to search for the start of an event overlapping the window, and after until for its recovery; defaults to 1209600 (14 days), IODA's default. Values above 1209600 are served as 1209600 with a notice. Large extensions on type-only rankings can time out; zero may miss long-running detections.

from.description: Inclusive Unix seconds UTC; no milliseconds; window at most 31 days.

ignoreMethods.description: Detection methods to exclude upstream before event construction and scoring; duplicates are removed, and an empty array excludes nothing. Keep fixed across ranking and drill-down calls.

items.description: One detection method exclusion; case and surrounding whitespace are normalized.

limit.description: Upstream page size; values above 100 are served as 100 with a notice. Keep fixed when continuing.

page.description: Zero-based upstream page; restart at 0 when changing limit.

relatedToCode.description: Scope entity code, normalized like entityCode for relatedToType (IR, 1829, AS42337, 60627-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities. Provide with relatedToType.

relatedToType.description: Scope type: country, region, asn, or geoasn. With relatedToCode, returns entityType entities related to that entity, such as the regions or networks of one country. Requires entityType and excludes entityCode; blank is omitted. Outage membership coverage is unverified independently of row pagination; page ioda_search_entities and query selected codes individually.

until.description: Inclusive Unix seconds UTC for transition/event-start selection, after from and no later than now; adjacent windows can duplicate boundary detections.

name: ioda_summarize_outages

applied.description: Every normalized input, effective window, filter and pagination value.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_entity`: entityCode is incompatible with entityType, zero or out of range. `invalid_scope`: relatedToType and relatedToCode are incomplete or incompatible, the code is zero or out of range, or a scope comes with entityCode. `invalid_window`: Reversed, future, millisecond, or over-31-day window. `upstream_bad_request`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 400 or an error envelope. `upstream_unprocessable`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 422. `entity_not_found`: IODA returns an explicit entity 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: IODA returns HTTP 429. `upstream_queue_full`: The shared request queue is full. `upstream_timeout`: IODA does not answer within the per-attempt timeout or the invocation deadline; type-only rankings such as every region are the slowest, and slow further as extendWindowSeconds and the window grow. `upstream_schema`: IODA summary rows lack an entity, a numeric scores.overall, or an integer event_cnt, or carry a non-numeric score. `response_too_large`: The upstream body or combined response exceeds its byte budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Result interpretation and concrete next call.

more.description: Whether another row page may exist; no does not verify related-scope membership coverage

nextPage.description: Next page when another may exist and IODA can continue the request; absent from a full page it cannot continue, whose notice names the route to the rest

endpoint.description: Fixed HTTPS IODA upstream endpoint URL

summaries.description: IODA's per-entity summaries in its own order, descending scores.overall.

items.description: One entity's unmodified IODA outage summary for the window

subnames.description: Additional source names, preserved verbatim: usually a list; geoasn search rows carry named parts such as asn and region or country

event_cnt.description: IODA's count of the entity's source events before merging

scores.description: Unmodified window-total scores: overall plus one sum of event scores per <source>.<method> key, such as bgp.median or gtr.sarima

overall.description: IODA's ranking score: overlapping events from different sources are merged, each merged event scores the product of its sources' scores, and overall sums the merged events

truncated.description: A full page may have further records; not an exact total.

title: Ioda Summarize Outages
